name: Welcome!
objectiveText: Bring the Shadowglen Gift Voucher to Orenthil Whisperwind . Shadowglen Gift Voucher (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: Orenthil Whisperwind, where can he be found?
I think it's a panda or the other pet, you can only get from the collecters edition

It is for the collector's edition. Every character gets one on a collectors edition account. You get to chose from a Mini Diablo, a Mini Zergling, or a Panda. They follow you around like any other pet, and are summoned by an inventory item given to you upon completion.

The persons to deliver the gift to is located a few feet away from the place your character starts, and gets a yellow "?" as a normal quest NPC, once you have taken the quest.

Edited, Mon Nov 14 19:06:26 2005
In classic, this quest will only be available to those who purchased the original WoW collectors edition and have it tied to their account.
